description: Shared by EFormSelectApPrefillUnitTest (the server) and scripts/eform-select-prefill-fixture-check.js (a real browser). Each case: the select as the template has it, the database output, the markup after the edit, and the value a browser submits for it; the edit must change no option's value or text. Each read: a page, and the value a browser submits for its select named a with the page's first form (null: none), which a database tag that names the field must bind. FAKE data only.

cases.name: an end tag written with a space
an optgroup label that looks like an option
cases.before: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><optgroup label="<option value=B>"><option value="A">a</option><option value="B">b</option></optgroup></select>
cases.after: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><optgroup label="<option value=B>"><option value="A">a</option><option selected value="B">b</option></optgroup></select>

cases.name: an option inside inert template content
cases.after: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="A">a</option><template><option value="B">tpl</option></template><option selected value="B">b</option></select>

cases.name: a script that holds select markup
cases.before: <script>var s='<select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="B">';</script><select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="A">a</option><option value="B">b</option></select>
cases.after: <script>var s='<select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="B">';</script><select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="A">a</option><option selected value="B">b</option></select>

cases.name: a comment inside an option's text
cases.after: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option>Yes<!-- note --> now</option><option selected value="Yes">real</option></select>

cases.name: a raw spelling match first, the exact submitted value later
cases.before: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="Smith & Sons">decoded</option><option value="Smith &amp; Sons">raw</option></select>
cases.after: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="Smith & Sons">decoded</option><option selected value="Smith &amp; Sons">raw</option></select>

cases.name: a template default after the stored value's option
a select that holds a style element is left as the template has it
cases.before: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="A" selected>a</option><style><option value="B"></style><option value="B">b</option></select>
cases.after: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="A" selected>a</option><style><option value="B"></style><option value="B">b</option></select>

cases.name: a comment in the select that mentions a style tag
cases.before: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="No" selected>n</option><!-- old <style> block was removed --><option value="Yes">y</option></select>
cases.after: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="No">n</option><!-- old <style> block was removed --><option selected value="Yes">y</option></select>

cases.name: an option group label that holds a style tag
a script in the select that holds a style tag
cases.before: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="No" selected>n</option><script>var s = '<style>';</script><option value="Yes">y</option></select>
cases.after: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value="No">n</option><script>var s = '<style>';</script><option selected value="Yes">y</option></select>

cases.name: a no-break space in an option's text is not the stored space
a stored no-break space chooses the option whose text holds one
an em space inside an unquoted value belongs to the value
cases.before: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value=Plan selected>p</option><option value="B" selected>b</option><option value="C">c</option></select>
cases.after: <select name="a" oscarDB=choice><option value=Plan selected>p</option><option value="B">b</option><option selected value="C">c</option></select>

reads.name: a drop-down with no option marked submits its first enabled option
a list box with no option marked submits nothing
a size of 0 still shows a drop-down
a size is read past white space and a plus sign
a size is read up to the first character that is not a digit
a size of 1.5 reads as 1
a multiple select submits its first selected option that is not disabled
reads.form: <form><select name="a" multiple><optgroup label="old" disabled><option selected>Legacy</option></optgroup><option selected>Current</option><option selected>Later</option></select></form>

reads.name: a multiple select with no option marked submits nothing
a select without options submits nothing
a shown option that is disabled submits nothing
a selected option in a disabled option group submits nothing
the first enabled option is past a disabled option group, in an enabled one
a same-named select in inert template content
a same-named select in another form
a same-named select whose form attribute names another form
a same-named select whose form attribute is empty
a select outside the saved form whose form attribute names it
a form written between table and tr owns the select of its row
a commented-out select is not read
option text keeps a no-break space and leaves out a comment, a script and template content
a select that holds a style element submits the option a browser lists
reads.form: <form><select name="a"><option value="A" selected>a</option><style><option value="B" selected></style><template><option value="T" selected>t</option></template><option value="B">b</option></select></form>
